user_query: I'm organizing a team-building event for my company. Please provide me with a collection of programming memes to use as icebreakers and promote a fun atmosphere. Additionally, find a Chuck Norris joke related to teamwork to include in the event's presentation. Lastly, search for some humorous jokes from the Jokes by API-Ninjas API to entertain the participants during breaks.

TaskList.description: Collect a variety of programming memes to use as icebreakers for the event.
Find a Chuck Norris joke that relates to teamwork for the event presentation.
Retrieve humorous jokes from the Jokes by API-Ninjas API to entertain participants during breaks.
